in_hebrew.name: Pierson
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Son of Pierce
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Pierson הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English name Pierce, which was derived from the Latin name Percival or Percivius. This name means 'Son of Percival' or 'Son of Percivius'. Percival was a legendary knight of King Arthur's Round Table. The name became popular in England during the Middle Ages.
